hints.title: Table Join
hints.text: Join emails and texts using email_id to link signup dates with verification dates.

hints.title: Action Filter
hints.text: Filter for rows where signup_action equals Verified.

hints.title: Second Day Condition
hints.text: Filter for actions occurring exactly 1 day after the signup date using date difference = 1.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT e.user_id
FROM emails e
JOIN texts t ON e.email_id = t.email_id
WHERE t.signup_action = 'Verified'
  AND DATEDIFF(t.action_date, e.signup_date) = 1
ORDER BY e.user_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Hash join on email_id followed by date filtering.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single join is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for joined records.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use date difference functions properly and filter verified status.

solutions.code:
SELECT e.user_id
FROM emails e
JOIN texts t ON e.email_id = t.email_id
WHERE t.signup_action = 'Verified'
  AND DATEDIFF(t.action_date, e.signup_date) = 1
ORDER BY e.user_id ASC;

SELECT e.user_id
FROM emails e
JOIN texts t ON e.email_id = t.email_id
WHERE t.signup_action = 'Verified'
  AND t.action_date::date - e.signup_date::date = 1
ORDER BY e.user_id ASC;
